notes.title: Improvement Update #21: Paludarium Inventory Table
notes.content:

notes.title: Improvement Update #17: Paludarium System
notes.content:
Hello, Aquascapers! 

In our latest update, we're thrilled to unveil the [b]Paludarium System[/b], a captivating addition to the Aquascapers universe. The Paludarium System brings a captivating twist to Aquascapers, offering players the opportunity to create unique aquatic landscapes in much larger fish tank. Players can dive into the Paludarium work process, which takes place in the expansion room adjacent to the main home base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1fd07a67def5c81512cf88da3052bd5c640ba885.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d66b592b4233e8a41219d9dbc3b113bc2d059fd1.png[/img]

While the Paludarium system shares similarities with the aquascape system, there are notable differences. One such distinction is the introduction of Paludarium special missions and unique paludarium items, particularly rocks and woods. To unlock the Paludarium system, players must first attain the [b]Level S License[/b] and [b]unlock the business expansion for Paludarium Business.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e1b1ca7b15c7ff514bcb668f61a6803054c9c3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/e6367930a178a54469acdae9bd414bdb95c2386c.png[/img]

Once these prerequisites are met, players will receive a Paludarium mission email and they get permission to search for Paludarium-specific rocks and woods items in the wild. Unlike regular aquarium decorations, rocks and woods items are specially designed for arranging larger paludariums, adding an extra layer of depth and complexity to the landscape. These items can be collected from the wild, adding an exciting element of exploration to the gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/99969c829aafe0b2b5f4c1f04c852498ff99f18f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/90abbb1de8e8678f89e73a8d2c4f7bdf6455ea7c.png[/img]

In addition to rocks and woods, players can use the same plants and fish as those used in aquascaping to populate their paludariums. These items can be sourced from the wild or obtained through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497458427651]cultivation [/url]and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497478629615]breeding[/url]. 

Upon completing their Paludarium, players can participate in auctions to sell their creations to fellow Paludarium enthusiasts. This interactive feature allows players to select from available auctions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/97d6d680a17890ad8b62cdc531c77dbb3bce0e45.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d89bdadd0ff1a795ebf8f7cc6ba5b62851c01cf8.png[/img]

However, the challenge of making a paludarium lies in its scale and complexity, requiring players to hone their skills and creativity to overcome the obstacles. Despite the challenges, creating a paludarium offers a rewarding experience that can significantly improve players' skills and abilities in aquatic landscaping. Get ready to embark on this exciting journey and discover the endless possibilities of the Paludarium System in Aquascapers!

To access the latest enhancements, simply restart your Steam client or utilize the verify integration option in the game's properties. [b]Look out for the new version marked as v2024.18.4 [3bab3cd], visible in the bottom left corner of the main menu.[/b]

If you encounter any further issues or have additional feedback, please feel free to share them in the discussion.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐠

notes.title: Improvement Update #15: Road to Paludarium - Plant Cultivation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1c9b88a94ddc8eb706b7790f614f86d7937e1b46.png[/img]

Hello, Aquascapers!

In our latest game update, we're thrilled to introduce the [b]Plant Cultivation[/b] feature to Aquascapers. Now, players have the opportunity to unleash their inner botanist and cultivate a variety of plants right from the comfort of their home base. To begin cultivating plants, players must first upgrade their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497460990729]Room Expansion[/url] at home base, unlocking the new room where all plant cultivation activities will take place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8b376288d34caa94f7e2987ab6599969207578e1.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8513653744b5565e64e555de757695dc372b87bf.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/77d5cc19426ca3a484f4d8e1be1a7b42c434ec08.png[/img]

Unlocking the plant expansion feature requires players to have sufficient story points and money, adding a new dimension to their gameplay experience. Once unlocked, players can embark on a botanical journey, nurturing their plants through various stages of growth, from small seedlings to thriving botanical wonders. This immersive process allows players to witness the evolution of their plants firsthand, adding a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment to their aquascaping endeavors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/6e4508156a942895532adfd2ca9c46818557713e.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1db713c8879545d8624ca8aaff5af5e2818e68a7.png[/img]

After the plants have matured and been harvested, the cultivation box will be emptied, ready to be used for another round of cultivation. This efficient cycle ensures a continuous supply of plant items without the need to venture into the forest for resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/b80fcf0e11c009958702b6dca131c327522cec59.png[/img]

One of the most convenient aspects of plant cultivation is the ability to obtain plant items without the need to venture into the forest. With plants readily available in their home base, players can save time and effort while still reaping the rewards of their green-fingered efforts. Whether you're a seasoned gardener or just starting out, plant cultivation in Aquascapers offers a rewarding and enjoyable experience for players of all levels.

So, get ready to roll up your sleeves, and watch your botanical creations come to life in Aquascapers.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿

notes.title: Improvement Update #14: Update on "Fish Breeding" Terms
notes.content:
In response to valuable feedback from our community, we're pleased to announce an important update to our game: the term "Fish Cultivation" has been officially changed to "[b]Fish Breeding[/b]." This update reflects our commitment to accuracy and authenticity in representing aquascaping practices.

Upon careful consideration and further research prompted by player input, we confirmed that "Fish Breeding" is indeed the more appropriate term for the process depicted in our game. As such, we have swiftly implemented this change to ensure alignment with industry standards and best practices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a954690c8915a68243316dd13f9039f41d098500.png[/img]

This update underscores our dedication to customer collaboration in the development of our game products. We greatly value the insights and contributions of our players, recognizing their role in shaping the evolution of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/5cb8e198c832bf46c79d3afdfcbdbffa0245d925.png[/img]

Moving forward, players can expect to see the term "Fish Breeding" used consistently throughout the game interface and accompanying documentation. We believe that this change will enhance the overall gaming experience and provide a more accurate portrayal of the aquascaping activities depicted in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1dee57fc7d4c2a6d0e9f3c8b0d8f4c2caf967291.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a7b3007ca622a50beefed8d683573b74b69d5bd8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/08acaf3505253c2ef8202bab25fe00cd61f1fa87.png[/img]

As always, we remain open to further input and feedback from our community. Your insights are invaluable in driving continuous improvement and innovation in our game. Together, let's continue to cultivate an engaging and authentic gaming experience that resonates with aquascapers worldwide.

Thank you for your ongoing support, and happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐟

notes.title: Improvement Update #13: Road to Paludarium - Fish Cultivation
notes.content:
Hello, Aquascapers!

As we continue to expand and evolve our aquascaping ventures, we're excited to introduce the next stage of business development: [b]Fish Cultivation[/b]. This significant milestone follows the successful implementation of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497460990729]Room Expansion[/url] and offers players the opportunity to unlock new possibilities within their aquascape business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/af9d6320f5a991799a2515fd38e10afb0b1e820c.png[/img]

Fish Cultivation takes place within the expansion room, conveniently located adjacent to the main home base. Within this designated area, players will find five cultivation boxes designed to nurture fish from their juvenile stages to adulthood. This streamlined process eliminates the need for traditional fishing methods, allowing players to efficiently cultivate their desired fish species without the hassle of fishing in the wild.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/c5d241e4b352faac7a5d5d7484563ea81f32f919.png[/img]

One of the key benefits of fish cultivation is its efficiency. By cultivating fish, players can obtain their desired species reliably and save valuable time that would otherwise be spent fishing in various locations. Unlike traditional fishing, where multiple attempts may be required to capture specific species, fish cultivation provides a more direct and streamlined approach to acquiring aquatic companions for your aquascape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/73fc425d35e1745883ca1af8fafedea6d9ba89c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/db04cd9afdf968e44dd0ad2f9dbdb767c852a634.png[/img]

While fish cultivation offers numerous advantages, it's essential to consider the limitations of traditional fishing methods. Fishing in the wild can be time-consuming and unpredictable, requiring players to invest significant effort in locating and capturing desired fish species. Additionally, identifying the correct fishing locations can pose a challenge, further complicating the process.

By embracing this feature, players can enhance their efficiency, streamline their operations, and unlock new opportunities for creativity and success in the world of aquascaping.

Prepare to immerse yourself in the captivating world of fish cultivation and elevate your aquascaping game to new heights. Happy aquascaping! 🐟✨

notes.title: Unveiling Fisheria: A Tranquil Mountain Retreat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/00dd8b478da668a6189111ca3e5d6feb91de3d83.png[/img]

Hello, Aquascapers!

We’re excited to introduce the third exploration area, [b]Fisheria[/b], a captivating environment nestled within rocky mountains. Get ready for a journey filled with gathering opportunities, scenic views, and the joy of fishing in the serene lake.

[h3]Exploring Fisheria: The Rocky Mountain Oasis[/h3]
Fisheria invites you to immerse yourself in a unique landscape, where rocky cliffs, lush vegetation, and crystal-clear waters come together to create a picturesque setting. This new environment is rich with resources waiting to be discovered, providing you with a fresh array of materials to enhance your aquascape designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/f68ae766cfe5fe26c063dfa61c2059ec8aae4561.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a01ecc7cc76bcd239acf78fabc61274981965083.png[/img]

[h3]Gather Pine Wood and Rocks: Nature's Building Blocks[/h3]
Head into the heart of Fisheria, where towering pine trees and weathered rocks await discovery. Explore the area near the rocky cliffs to find valuable pine wood, a versatile material for creating stunning hardscapes in your aquascapes. Don't forget to scour the surroundings for rocks, which can add a touch of rugged beauty and serve as natural anchors for your underwater creations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/261a83f333ddb2024398a6949fe060bb1f6d6309.jpg[/img]

[h3]Abundant Aquatic Plants: Add Life and Vibrancy[/h3]
Fisheria is also home to a diverse array of aquatic plants, providing you with endless options for adding life and vibrancy to your aquascapes. Take a leisurely stroll along the edge of the lake area to discover unique aquatic plants that thrive in this rocky mountain oasis. Incorporate these plants into your designs to create captivating underwater landscapes that will mesmerize both you and your clients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/bb342a5539c647caa838e120a79e94951c66e719.png[/img]

While exploring the serene lake area of Fisheria, bring your fishing gear! Exercise caution and approach fishing spots quietly to avoid startling the fish. Experience the thrill of capturing the finest specimens to showcase in your aquascapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/916d7b8cfed1aee94c101b31c867d3151a4e023d.jpg[/img]

Fisheria beckons, offering a rocky mountain oasis where gathering pine wood, rocks, aquatic plants, and fishing await. Unleash your creativity and let the beauty of this new environment inspire your aquascape designs. Immerse yourself in the tranquil ambiance, explore the rich resources, and create breathtaking underwater landscapes that will captivate the eyes and hearts of your clients.

Cheers!

notes.title: Reviving Resources: A Deeper Dive into Respawn Mechanics in Aquascape Simulator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/29e450154242ceb099ea1509e84879e036c499dd.png[/img]

Hello, Aquascapers!

In the latest version of Aquascape Simulator, we have implemented an exciting game mechanic to encourage exploration and discovery of new areas. We understand that the thrill of uncovering resources is an integral part of the gameplay experience. With our [b]Respawn Mechanic[/b], every item you gather will have the chance to reappear in the same location, allowing you to revisit previously explored areas and discover new gathering spots.

[h3]The Respawn Mechanic Explained[/h3]
Here's how it works: Once you've collected an item from a particular location, such as near a large tree, along the edge of a stream, or around a prominent rock, the item will temporarily disappear from that spot. However, it will eventually respawn after a certain period of time, giving you another opportunity to gather it.

[h3]Your Guide to Exploration: The Enviro Map Menu[/h3]
To aid you in your exploration, we have included the Enviro Map Menu. Within this menu, you can easily track the availability of items across various locations. The items that have not yet respawned will be marked with transparent icons, indicating that they are currently unavailable. This feature empowers you to plan your gathering expeditions, ensuring that you're always aware of the status of each item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e8204f9ca99a25098e78174c4d01e4e378463e2.png[/img]

[h3]Embrace the Dynamic Aquascaping World[/h3]
By implementing this respawn mechanic, we aim to foster a sense of adventure and encourage players to explore different areas of the game world. As you traverse the lush landscapes, be sure to keep an eye out for new gathering spots and hidden gems that may have respawned since your last visit. Each location holds its own unique set of hardscapes, plants, and fish, waiting to be discovered and collected.

Remember, patience is key. If you arrive at a previously visited spot and find that the item you're looking for is not there, don't be discouraged. It simply means that the respawn timer has not yet elapsed. Take this opportunity to explore other areas, diversify your gathering locations, and expand your knowledge of the game world.

Aquascape Simulator invites you to embark on an exciting journey of exploration, resource gathering, and creativity. Through the respawn mechanic, we hope to provide a dynamic and ever-changing environment that rewards curiosity and encourages players to venture into uncharted territories.

So, grab your tablet, consult the Enviro Map Menu, and set out to uncover the bountiful treasures that await you.

notes.title: Elevating Usability with UI/UX Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/6afb5ff6ce62c5054add790c0f718cd47e0ebec5.png[/img]

Hello, aquascapers!

We are delighted to share recent refinements to our user interface and user experience (UI/UX) based on valuable insights gleaned from playtesting with our internal team and a circle of alpha testers. Our primary focus has been on improving usability to ensure that your journey into aquascape design is as seamless and engaging as possible. Let's delve into the details!

[h2]Playtesting: A Crucial Step[/h2]
As developers, we fully grasp the significance of gathering feedback from our players. That's precisely why we conducted extensive playtesting sessions with both our in-house team and a dedicated group of alpha testers who share our passion for aquascaping. Their input has proven invaluable in pinpointing areas where we could enhance the gameplay experience.

[h2]Revamped UI: An Intuitive and Visually Pleasing Interface[/h2]
One of the pivotal aspects we concentrated on was the user interface (UI). Our objective was to craft an interface that not only boasts a stunning appearance but also facilitates effortless navigation through the game's features. After careful deliberation, we settled on a clean and intuitive design that provides a seamless experience.

The updated UI offers convenient access to essential tools and features, allowing you to explore, gather aquascape materials, and craft your finest aquascapes. We meticulously organized the interface to ensure that every element finds its rightful place, reducing clutter and rendering it a pleasure to use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a2f66e518173a53af83952806517df1a09201b9d.png[/img]

[h2]Streamlined UX: Smooth and Enjoyable Gameplay[/h2]
In conjunction with the UI, we also directed our efforts toward enhancing the user experience (UX). Our aim was to eliminate potential sources of frustration and offer a gaming experience that immerses you fully in the art of aquascaping. The feedback from playtesting aided us in identifying areas where we could simplify interactions and clarify objectives.

With the upgraded UX, you can anticipate clear and concise prompts that guide you through each stage of your aquascape design process. We've ensured that instructions and objectives are conveyed effectively, empowering you to express your creativity without any ambiguity. Our goal is to minimize the time spent deciphering mechanics, allowing you to invest more time in refining your designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/0326b174ea4bc988af47ca5967cb563d0f1f9da4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Feedback: Fuel for Progress[/h2]
The feedback we received from both our internal testers and alpha testers who participated in the playtests has been overwhelmingly positive. We extend our heartfelt thanks to the community for actively contributing to the shaping of Aquascape Simulator. Your feedback has played a pivotal role in guiding our development process and enabling us to create an experience that deeply resonates with aquascape enthusiasts.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
Our commitment to delivering an exceptional gaming experience doesn't stop here. We will remain dedicated to listening to our players and diligently implementing further refinements based on your feedback. We believe that a community-driven approach is essential in creating a game that evolves with your needs and desires.

Anticipate to regular updates and exciting new features that will keep Aquascape Simulator fresh and captivating. We are enthusiastic about continuing this journey alongside you and delivering an even more immersive aquascape design experience.

Thank you for being a part of the Aquascape Simulator community. Get ready to unleash your inner aquascaping virtuoso as we dive into the fascinating world of aquascape design together!

Cheers!

notes.title: Exploring Sandbox Mode in Aquascape Design
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/2799a83fdd27d66edd90ecd544dbc445bad22cba.png[/img]

Hello, aquascapers!

Aquascape Simulator introduces a simulation experience where you can craft a virtual aquarium brimming with diverse hardscape elements, aquatic flora, and aquatic life. At the heart of this game lies the Sandbox Mode, offering you a canvas to arrange your aquascape freely and imaginatively. Dive into this Sandbox Mode for a truly immersive experience in designing your aquascapes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/3675548970078774570][b]The Sandbox Mode[/b][/url] within Aquascape Simulator offers a range of functions to aid you in composing your ideal aquascape. You have the flexibility to rotate the fish tank, viewing it from different angles. Furthermore, you can employ the zoom-in feature to inspect intricate details of the items within your aquarium, or opt for the zoom-out feature for a comprehensive view of your aquascape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/110d963b6c9eec669b38e18a28364b672d657cc4.png[/img]

Within the Sandbox Mode, you can expertly position hardscape items, aquatic plants, and fish within your virtual aquarium. Simply select your preferred items from the inventory panel and place them into the aquarium. As you place items into your aquascape, the inventory stock will adjust according to the quantity of items chosen. Additionally, you have the liberty to rearrange or shift the placement of items within the aquarium to achieve a fresh appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/65acd1519c98dd9096e9a8bac34cc82bef6e49a0.png[/img]

Should you find certain items unsuitable for your envisioned aquascape, the option to remove them is at your disposal. However, it's worth noting that deleted items bid adieu both from your aquarium and inventory. Conversely, you can safeguard hardscape items, aquatic plants, and fish that have graced your aquarium, preserving them within your inventory for potential future deployments.

[h2]Aquarium Template[/h2]
Sandbox mode in Aquascape Simulator extends the convenience of saving your meticulously crafted aquarium designs as templates. This means you can preserve your artistic creations for future reference. Rest assured, these saved aquarium templates can be easily reconstructed, provided you possess the required items in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1a87848e78664568a32dcd630aa615cb7789355a.png[/img]

If you have any queries regarding the features discussed or any aspect of Aquascape Simulator, we welcome your comments and suggestions on our discussion forum. Your input holds immense value to us.

Don't forget to add Aquascape Simulator to your wishlist. Doing so will ensure you are kept well-informed about the latest news and updates regarding the game. We eagerly anticipate sharing more exciting developments with you in the near future!

Cheers!

notes.title: Terraforming : Altering Terrain Shape in Aquascape
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/12f387868b3b9dd01fb887eab212ace47c0ccb26.jpg[/img]

Hello Aquascapers,

Today, we’re diving into the captivating world of terraforming in Aquascape Simulator. This remarkable feature empowers you to shape and mold the very landscape of your underwater masterpiece. You can adjust the radius of the area affected by terraforming effect, as well as select several terrain setting features such as Raise, Lower, Flatten, and Smoothen.


[h2]Raise : Ascend to New Heights[/h2]

The Raise feature is your gateway to elevating specific areas within your aquascape. Picture sculpting gentle hillocks or majestic underwater mountains. With Raise, you're the master of altitude, effortlessly conjuring the desired heights for your aquatic terrain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8c2845f315775056470989ef0246a21dee923c54.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lower : Delve into the Depths[/h2]

Imagine crafting serene valleys, tranquil lakes, or meandering rivers within your aquascape. The Lower feature empowers you to gracefully lower the terrain, creating mesmerizing water features and intricate topographical variations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/77427dfa39fc8195b269731f9827bd06154e4532.jpg[/img]

[h2]Flatten : For Harmonious Horizon[/h2]

Flatten takes center stage when you seek a balanced canvas for your aquascape masterpiece. Say goodbye to lumps and bumps as you wield the transformative Flatten tool. Smooth out uneven ground, ensuring a broad expanse of beauty for your aquatic realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/0628f34985e6887ad6bd6cd715c58e50cc13bb28.jpg[/img]

[h2]Smoothen : A Brush with Elegance[/h2]

The Smoothen feature brings a touch of finesse to your aquascape, erasing any traces of rough edges or jagged lines. As you utilize Smoothen, those artistic ripples left behind by Raise and Lower gracefully dissolve, culminating in a natural and lifelike aesthetic for your underwater haven.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7cc9338901759c58b6498ceaa182ef5639f55078.jpg[/img]


By utilizing the terraforming feature, you can set the affected area's radius, enabling you to decide which areas will be altered and which ones will remain unchanged. This provides you with the flexibility to modify only specific areas while leaving the rest untouched.

If these insights have ignited your curiosity, don't hesitate to engage with us. Drop a comment or join the lively discourse on our discussion forum – your thoughts and queries are most welcome!

And remember, the path to aquatic artistry begins with a simple click. Wishlist Aquascape Simulator today, and embark on a journey to witness the evolution of your underwater opus. Stay tuned for the latest updates and news, and until next time, may your waves be tranquil and your creativity boundless.

Best fishes for a fantastic day!

We're beyond excited to introduce you to our game - Aquascape Simulator! 🌿🐠 Get ready for a journey into the mesmerizing world of aquascaping. Dive in and explore nature, collect decorative items, co-op with your friends, and let your creativity flow as you design captivating aquascapes that'll leave everyone in awe.
